## Decision

1. D102 AccountStatusGate constructor change is a finite approved unpublished semantic delta under D64. Explicitly include scripts/bc/approved-deltas.json in P07.1 Files and scope. Preserve existing package entries; add tenancy entry at product execution only, bound to the resolved BC_CHECK_BASE revision actually used by bc-check (accepted-base.json by default), accepted D102/D103 source paths and exact SHA-256. Collect actual Roave JSON errors on the product candidate, approve only the declared constructor delta rows (description SHA-256, path, modificationType). PHP 8.4 accepts surplus arguments for this user-defined constructor, so the review's ArgumentCountError/current-proof-invalid assertion is not reproduced. Preserve raw report, record this evidence correction in triage, rerun current bodies/results. Add callback+cleanup with an initialized outer account to exercise actual previous-account restoration branch; current central scenario remains.
